jobs.title: Aviation Security Patrol Officer
jobs.description:
The City of San Antonio is hiring for an Airport Police Officer to protect the San Antonio International Airport and its complex, enforcing all laws and ordinances. The role involves patrolling, responding to emergencies, and coordinating with TSA and airport vendors.

Applicants must meet Texas Peace Officer licensing requirements, pass TSA and CJIS checks, and be able to work outdoors in varying conditions. The position is full-time and requires valid licensure and a clean background.
